_note: Chapter 20 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: He spoke English with a soft southern accent.
ex.cn: 他讲英语带着柔和的南方口音。
ex.note: accent n. 主要指“口音”；动词 accent /əˈsent/ 意为“强调、重读”

ex.en: The acquisition of the small firm took nearly a year to complete.
ex.cn: 收购这家小公司花了将近一年才完成。
ex.note: the acquisition of … …的获得/收购；a good acquisition 一桩好买卖

ex.en: Camping in the mountains was an adventure the children still talked about.
ex.cn: 在山里露营是一段孩子们至今还在谈论的冒险经历。
ex.note: a great adventure 一段非凡的冒险；go on an adventure 去冒险

ex.en: The morning air smelled of wet grass and warm bread.
ex.cn: 清晨的空气里带着湿草和热面包的气味。
ex.note: in the open air 在户外；an air of confidence 自信的神态

ex.en: The room should be aired before the guests arrive.
ex.cn: 客人来之前应该给房间通通风。
ex.note: air a room 给房间通风；air an opinion 公开表达看法

ex.en: It is amazing how quickly a free week disappears in summer.
ex.cn: 暑假里一周的空闲时间消失得有多快，真是惊人。
ex.note: amazing news 惊人的消息；an amazing coincidence 奇妙的巧合

ex.en: A line of ants was carrying crumbs across the garden path.
ex.cn: 一队蚂蚁正把面包屑搬过园子的小径。
ex.note: ants in one's pants 坐立不安

ex.en: She made an appointment with the bank for Monday morning.
ex.cn: 她预约了银行周一上午的时间。
ex.note: make/keep an appointment 预约；an appointment as manager 经理的职位

ex.en: The street artist painted a blue bird on the wall overnight.
ex.cn: 那位街头艺术家一夜之间在墙上画了一只蓝色的鸟。
ex.note: a famous artist 名画家；a recording artist 录音艺人

ex.en: Please attach your photograph to the form before you send it.
ex.cn: 寄出之前请把照片附在表格上。
ex.note: attach sth. to sth. 把…附在…上；attach importance to 重视

ex.en: Few people are aware of how much the river has changed.
ex.cn: 很少有人意识到这条河已经改变了多少。
ex.note: be aware of 意识到；be aware that … 知道……

ex.en: She had barely time to finish her breakfast before the bell rang.
ex.cn: 铃响之前，她几乎刚够时间吃完早饭。
ex.note: barely … 几乎不…；barely a year old 才一岁

ex.en: The old street looked beautiful in the late afternoon light.
ex.cn: 傍晚的光线里，这条老街看上去美极了。
ex.note: a beautiful day 美好的一天；beautifully dressed 衣着漂亮

ex.en: The main benefit of cycling to work is that it costs almost nothing.
ex.cn: 骑车上班的最大好处是几乎不花钱。
ex.note: a benefit of … …的好处；a benefit package 福利套餐

ex.en: Small shops will benefit from the new low-interest loans.
ex.cn: 小商家将从新的低息贷款中受益。
ex.note: benefit from 从…中受益

ex.en: She put a woollen blanket around the shoulders of the crying girl.
ex.cn: 她把一条毛毯披在那个哭泣女孩的肩上。
ex.note: a blanket of fog 一片浓雾；under a blanket 在毯子下面

ex.en: Long speeches bore everyone in the hall.
ex.cn: 冗长的演讲让大厅里所有人都听腻了。
ex.note: bore sb. 使某人厌烦；be bored with/about 厌烦

ex.en: The old warehouse on the canal is built of grey brick.
ex.cn: 运河边那座旧仓库是用灰砖砌成的。
ex.note: a brick wall 砖墙；drop the brick 放弃希望

ex.en: A bird was singing somewhere deep in the bushes.
ex.cn: 灌木丛深处有鸟在唱歌。
ex.note: the bushes 灌木丛；bush telegraph 野外传讯

ex.en: A narrowboat moved slowly along the canal behind the old houses.
ex.cn: 一条窄船沿着老房子后面的运河缓缓驶过。
ex.note: the Suez Canal 苏伊士运河；a canal boat 运河船

ex.en: He paid for the meal in cash because the machine had broken down.
ex.cn: 机器坏了，他用现金付了饭钱。
ex.note: in cash 用现金；cash on delivery 货到付款

ex.en: You can cash the cheque at any branch of the bank.
ex.cn: 这张支票在任何一家银行网点都能兑现。
ex.note: cash a cheque 兑现支票

ex.en: The training course ends with a certificate that employers recognise.
ex.cn: 这门培训课结束时颁发一份雇主认可的证书。
ex.note: a medical certificate 医疗证明；issue a certificate 发证书

ex.en: He had never been good at chemistry at school.
ex.cn: 他在学校里化学一向不好。
ex.note: a chemistry teacher 化学老师；human chemistry 人际间的化学反应

ex.en: The report cites several examples from last year's data.
ex.cn: 这份报告引用了去年数据中的几个例子。
ex.note: cite a source 引用出处；cite sb. for sth. 因某事表彰某人

ex.en: She wiped the dusty table with a damp cloth.
ex.cn: 她用一块湿布擦掉了桌上的灰。
ex.note: a piece of cloth 一块布；clothes 衣服（复数）

ex.en: The report describes the long combat between the two families.
ex.cn: 报告描述了这两户人家之间漫长的争斗。
ex.note: in combat 处于战斗之中；combat against 与…斗争

ex.en: The new law is intended to combat online fraud.
ex.cn: 这项新法旨在打击网络诈骗。
ex.note: combat a problem 解决/防止某个问题

ex.en: Small shops find it hard to compete with the big chains.
ex.cn: 小商店很难与大型连锁店竞争。
ex.note: compete with 与…竞争；compete for 争夺；compete on price 打价格战

ex.en: They reached no conclusion after two days of talks.
ex.cn: 谈了两天，他们仍没有得出结论。
ex.note: draw/reach a conclusion 得出结论；come to the conclusion that … 得出这样的结论

ex.en: He holds conservative views about how schools should be run.
ex.cn: 对学校该怎样办，他持保守的看法。
ex.note: a conservative estimate 保守的估计；conservative views 保守的观点

ex.en: The conservatives in parliament resisted the new law for months.
ex.cn: 议会里的保守派几个月来一直抗拒这项新法。
ex.note: a political conservative 政治上的保守分子

ex.en: There is a sharp contrast between the two versions of the story.
ex.cn: 这件事的两个版本之间有着尖锐的对比。
ex.note: in/by contrast 相比之下；a contrast to 与…形成对比

ex.en: The report contrasts life in the city with life on the farms.
ex.cn: 这份报告把城市生活与农场生活作了对比。
ex.note: contrast A with B 把 A 与 B 作对比

ex.en: A newspaper correspondent came to interview the mayor.
ex.cn: 一位报社记者赶来采访市长。
ex.note: a foreign correspondent 驻外记者；the correspondent of … …的通讯员

ex.en: A tall crane stood over the construction site all morning.
ex.cn: 一台高大的起重机整个上午都矗立在工地上。
ex.note: a crane 鹤；起重机；a crane neck 鹤颈

ex.en: He bought a small crystal bowl at the Sunday market.
ex.cn: 他在周日集市上买了一只小小的水晶碗。
ex.note: crystal clear 清澈的；a crystal ball 水晶球

ex.en: The children were warned to stay away from the water because of the danger.
ex.cn: 孩子们被警告远离水面，那儿有危险。
ex.note: in danger 处于危险中；a danger to 对…构成危险

ex.en: It was a hard decision to leave the job and start again.
ex.cn: 辞掉工作重新开始，是个艰难的决定。
ex.note: make/take a decision 做出决定；a decision to do 决定做某事

ex.en: Free elections are the foundation of a working democracy.
ex.cn: 自由选举是运转良好的民主制度的基础。
ex.note: a modern democracy 现代民主国家；representative democracy 代议制民主

ex.en: He felt that meeting her that summer had changed his destiny.
ex.cn: 他觉得那年夏天遇见她改变了自己的命运。
ex.note: a sense of destiny 命定感；seal one's destiny 决定命运

ex.en: It is difficult to stay calm when everything goes wrong at once.
ex.cn: 所有事情同时出错时，很难保持冷静。
ex.note: a difficult decision 艰难的决定；difficult for sb. to do 对某人来说做…很难

ex.en: She discovered a small leak in the pipe under the kitchen sink.
ex.cn: 她发现厨房水槽下面的管子有个小漏洞。
ex.note: discover that … 发现…；discover a way 找到办法

ex.en: The teacher divided the class into four small groups.
ex.cn: 老师把班级分成四个小组。
ex.note: divide A into B 把 A 分成 B；divide by 除以

ex.en: The plane began a slow downward glide toward the runway.
ex.cn: 飞机开始朝跑道缓缓下滑。
ex.note: a downward trend 下降的趋势；downward prices 下跌的价格

ex.en: They dumped the old chairs at the back of the yard.
ex.cn: 他们把旧椅子堆在院子后面的空地上。
ex.note: dump sth. 倾倒/扔掉；dump data 转储数据

ex.en: The builders left a dump of broken bricks beside the gate.
ex.cn: 建筑工人在大门旁留下一堆碎砖。
ex.note: a dump of 一堆…；a rubbish dump 垃圾堆

ex.en: The local economy depends heavily on summer tourism.
ex.cn: 当地经济在很大程度上依赖夏季旅游。
ex.note: the economy 经济；the national economy 国民经济

ex.en: Trust is the element that holds a small community together.
ex.cn: 信任是把一个小社区维系在一起的那一环。
ex.note: an element of … …的一个要素；a key element 关键要素

ex.en: Her parents encouraged her to study abroad and write home often.
ex.cn: 父母鼓励她出国留学，也常给家里写信。
ex.note: encourage sb. to do 鼓励某人做；encourage sb. in sth. 在某方面鼓励某人

ex.en: I don't envy him his success; he has paid a high price for it.
ex.cn: 我并不羡慕他的成功，那代价他付得不轻。
ex.note: envy sb. sth. 羡慕某人某物；out of envy 出于嫉妒

ex.en: Everything in the office was covered in a thin layer of dust.
ex.cn: 办公室里所有东西都蒙着一层薄薄的灰。
ex.note: everything but 除…之外一切都；not everything 并非一切

ex.en: The museum will exhibit the old coins for three months.
ex.cn: 博物馆将展出这批古钱币三个月。
ex.note: 动词读 /ɪɡˈzɪbɪt/；名词在美国英语中常读 /ˈeksɪbɪt/。exhibit sth. to sb. 向某人展示某物

ex.en: The best exhibit in the museum is the collection of old clocks.
ex.cn: 博物馆里最出色的展品是那批老钟。
ex.note: a museum exhibit 博物馆展品；an exhibit at a fair 展会上展出的物品

ex.en: It took extraordinary courage to admit the mistake in public.
ex.cn: 当众承认错误需要非凡的勇气。
ex.note: extraordinary effort 巨大的努力；extraordinary powers 特殊能力

ex.en: The handbook turned out to be a fantastic tool for new students.
ex.cn: 这本手册后来成了新生的一件绝妙工具。
ex.note: fantastic news 好得不得了；a fantastic idea 绝妙的主意

ex.en: Federal law in that country is stricter than the local rules.
ex.cn: 那个国家的联邦法律比地方法规更严格。
ex.note: federal government 联邦政府；federal law 联邦法律

ex.en: He has worked in finance for ten years since leaving university.
ex.cn: 大学毕业后他在金融业干了十年。
ex.note: a finance minister 财政部长；the finance team 财务团队

ex.en: A local bank agreed to finance the new sports centre.
ex.cn: 一家当地银行同意为新的体育中心提供资金。
ex.note: finance a project 为某项目提供资金

ex.en: The smell of flour and hot bread filled the whole street.
ex.cn: 面粉和热面包的香气飘满了整条街。
ex.note: flour and water 面糊；self-raising flour 自发面粉

ex.en: She kept the old letter as if she would keep it forever.
ex.cn: 她把那封旧信留着，仿佛要永远留下去。
ex.note: forever 永远；for ever and a day 永远地

ex.en: The freight train moved so slowly that we could walk beside it.
ex.cn: 那列货运火车走得太慢，我们都能在旁边走上一段。
ex.note: a freight train 货运列车；freight traffic 货运业务

ex.en: Before we go any further, let me check the figures once more.
ex.cn: 在继续往下之前，让我再核对一遍数字。
ex.note: go further 更进一步；further questions 更多的疑问；further information 补充资料

ex.en: The new law may further reduce the number of these crimes.
ex.cn: 这项新法也许会进一步减少此类犯罪。
ex.note: further sth. 促进某事；further development 进一步的发展

ex.en: An old gentleman offered to help her carry the heavy bags.
ex.cn: 一位老先生主动提出帮她提那些沉重的袋子。
ex.note: a gentleman 先生；gentlemanly behaviour 绅士风度

ex.en: He plays golf on Sunday mornings when the weather is good.
ex.cn: 天气好的时候，他星期天上午去打高尔夫。
ex.note: a golf club 高尔夫球杆；golf course 高尔夫球场

ex.en: She expressed her gratitude to everyone who had helped her.
ex.cn: 她向每一个帮助过她的人表示感谢。
ex.note: with gratitude 怀着感激；a letter of gratitude 感谢信

ex.en: He chewed a piece of gum while he waited for the bus.
ex.cn: 等公交的时候他嚼着一块口香糖。
ex.note: chewing gum 口香糖；gum disease 牙龈疾病

ex.en: There is a natural harmony between the two old buildings.
ex.cn: 这两座老建筑之间有一种天然的和美。
ex.note: in harmony with 与…和谐相处；a harmony of 和声

ex.en: A news helicopter circled above the burning field.
ex.cn: 一架新闻直升机在燃烧的田地上空盘旋。
ex.note: by helicopter 乘直升机；a helicopter crew 直升机机组

ex.en: The museum reopened in a historic building near the old port.
ex.cn: 博物馆在老港口附近一座有历史意义的建筑里重新开张。
ex.note: a historic moment 历史性时刻；historic buildings 历史建筑

ex.en: He became hostile the moment I asked about his old job.
ex.cn: 我一问到他的旧事，他的态度就变得充满敌意。
ex.note: be hostile to 对…怀有敌意；a hostile atmosphere 敌对气氛

ex.en: The quiet corner of the library looked ideal for reading.
ex.cn: 图书馆那个安静的角落看起来正适合读书。
ex.note: an ideal place 理想的地方；ideal weather 理想的天气

ex.en: The young teacher is an ideal of patience and kindness.
ex.cn: 这位年轻教师是耐心与善意的典范。
ex.note: an ideal of … …的理想/典范；the ideal 理想的状态

ex.en: The country imports most of its rice from abroad.
ex.cn: 这个国家的大部分稻米都从国外进口。
ex.note: 动词读 /ɪmˈpɔːt/；名词“进口货”读 /ˈɪmpɔːt/。import sth. from … 从…进口

ex.en: Rice and timber are the country's two chief imports.
ex.cn: 大米和木材是这个国家的两大进口商品。
ex.note: an import of … …的进口；imports and exports 进出口

ex.en: The children stayed indoors because of the heavy rain.
ex.cn: 因为大雨，孩子们都待在室内。
ex.note: indoors 在室内；outdoors 在户外

ex.en: Insects were flying around the porch lamp all evening.
ex.cn: 虫子整个晚上都在门廊的灯周围打转。
ex.note: an insect net 捕虫网；insect noise 虫鸣声

ex.en: It was interesting to hear how the town had changed in ten years.
ex.cn: 听到这座镇子在十年里的变化很有意思。
ex.note: an interesting person 有趣的人；interestingly 有意思的是

ex.en: It was still raining when the bus finally arrived.
ex.cn: 公交终于到的时候，雨还在下。
ex.note: it 作非人称主语；It is … that … 强调句

ex.en: The heat arrived in June and stayed until October.
ex.cn: 暑热在六月到来，一直待到十月。
ex.note: in June 在六月；June the first 六月一日

ex.en: The rope was tied in a tight knot that would not come undone.
ex.cn: 绳子打成了一个解不开的死结。
ex.note: tie a knot 打结；a knot of 一团；knot speed 节（航速单位）

ex.en: The students launched a campaign against food waste.
ex.cn: 学生们发起了一场反对食物浪费的行动。
ex.note: launch a campaign 发起运动；launch a product 推出产品

ex.en: The launch of the new guide was held in the main hall.
ex.cn: 新指南的发布仪式在主楼大厅举行。
ex.note: the launch of … …的推出/首发；a rocket launch 火箭发射

ex.en: In his leisure hours he reads history and collects old maps.
ex.cn: 空闲的时候他读历史书，还收集旧地图。
ex.note: at leisure 闲暇时；leisure activities 休闲活动

ex.en: The team had limited time and very little money.
ex.cn: 团队时间有限，钱也很少。
ex.note: be limited to 限于；limited resources 有限的资源

ex.en: It was a long walk back to the dormitory in the dark.
ex.cn: 摸黑走回宿舍是一段很长的路。
ex.note: a long time 长时间；long ago 很久以前；no longer 不再

ex.en: Many students long for a quiet place to study.
ex.cn: 许多学生渴望一个安静的学习地方。
ex.note: long for sth. 渴望得到；long to do 渴望做

ex.en: The children believed that the old well was full of magic.
ex.cn: 孩子们相信那口老井里藏满了魔法。
ex.note: as if by magic 神奇地；black magic 巫术

ex.en: There is no magic formula for learning a language well.
ex.cn: 学好一门语言没有什么神奇的公式。
ex.note: a magic number 神奇的数字；magic moment 神奇时刻

ex.en: He left a small mark on the wall to show where the box had been.
ex.cn: 他在墙上留了一道小记号，标明箱子原来放的地方。
ex.note: a mark of … …的标志；a question mark 问号

ex.en: The teacher marked the essays and returned them on Friday.
ex.cn: 老师批改了作文，周五发还给学生。
ex.note: mark a price 标价；mark sth. as … 把…标记为

ex.en: They ate a simple meal of meat and rice in the dorm.
ex.cn: 他们在宿舍里吃了一顿简单的肉饭。
ex.note: a piece of meat 一块肉；meat and potatoes 主力军

ex.en: The lecture begins at midday and ends before the heat of the afternoon.
ex.cn: 讲座正午开始，在下午最热之前结束。
ex.note: at midday 在正午；the midday break 午休

ex.en: She often misunderstands the question and answers the wrong one.
ex.cn: 她误解了问题，结果答错了题。
ex.note: misunderstand sb. 误解某人；be misunderstood 被误解

ex.en: The train was still in motion when we jumped off.
ex.cn: 我们跳下车时，火车还在往前开。
ex.note: in motion 在运动中；a motion 动议

ex.en: He motioned to us to come closer and speak softly.
ex.cn: 他示意我们靠近一点，小声说话。
ex.note: motion to sb. to do 向某人示意做某事

ex.en: It is a myth that good students never ask questions.
ex.cn: 说优秀学生从不提问，那是个谬见。
ex.note: a popular myth 流行的谬见；myth and legend 神话与传说

ex.en: They moved into a quiet neighborhood near the river.
ex.cn: 他们搬进了河边一个安静的街区。
ex.note: in the neighbourhood 在附近；a working-class neighbourhood 工薪阶层街区

ex.en: None of the students had read the instructions carefully.
ex.cn: 没有一个学生仔细读过那些说明。
ex.note: none of … 一个也不；none other than 正是

ex.en: The school teaches children about nutrition and healthy eating.
ex.cn: 学校教孩子们营养知识和健康饮食。
ex.note: good nutrition 良好的营养；nutrition advice 营养建议

ex.en: A senior official at the bank promised a full investigation.
ex.cn: 银行的一位高级官员承诺要全面调查。
ex.note: a government official 政府官员；the highest official 最高级别的官员

ex.en: The warning on the website was an official notice from the university.
ex.cn: 网站上的警告是学校发布的正式通告。
ex.note: official records 官方记录；an official statement 官方声明

ex.en: He gave an oral report instead of a written one.
ex.cn: 他做了口头报告，而不是书面报告。
ex.note: an oral exam 口试；oral history 口述史

ex.en: Her work in the library during the crisis was outstanding.
ex.cn: 她在危机期间于图书馆的工作十分出色。
ex.note: outstanding debts 未偿还的债务；an outstanding achievement 杰出的成就

ex.en: A model of an old palace stood in the middle of the hall.
ex.cn: 大厅中央立着一座古城堡的模型。
ex.note: the Palace of Versailles 凡尔赛宫；a palace of justice 司法宫

ex.en: Waiting to be attacked is a passive way of staying safe.
ex.cn: 等着挨打是一种被动的自保方式。
ex.note: passive voice 被动语态；remain passive 保持被动

ex.en: Many people find it hard to ask for help when they are embarrassed.
ex.cn: 许多人感到难堪时很难开口求助。
ex.note: a people 一个民族；ordinary people 普通人

ex.en: His philosophy of life is simple: be useful to other people.
ex.cn: 他的人生观很简单：做一个对别人有用的人。
ex.note: a political philosophy 政治哲学；the school of philosophy 哲学流派

ex.en: The message was written in plain language that everyone could understand.
ex.cn: 这条信息用的是人人都看得懂的大白话。
ex.note: plain clothes 朴素的衣服；in plain words 简而言之

ex.en: A dirt road ran across the wide plain between the two hills.
ex.cn: 一条土路穿过两座山之间广阔的平原。
ex.note: the plains 平原；plain of 缺少（某种东西）的

ex.en: A policeman stood at the gate and checked our names.
ex.cn: 一名警察站在门口，核对了我们的姓名。
ex.note: a policeman in plain clothes 便衣警察；a policeman on duty 值班警察

ex.en: It is always possible to check the real address before you click.
ex.cn: 在点击之前，你随时可以核实真正的网址。
ex.note: as soon as possible 尽快；make it possible to do 使…成为可能

ex.en: The preliminary results look promising, but the final test comes later.
ex.cn: 初步结果看起来不错，不过最终测试还在后面。
ex.note: preliminary results 初步结果；preliminary steps 初步步骤

ex.en: The prisoner was taken to court the following morning.
ex.cn: 第二天上午，那名囚犯被带上了法庭。
ex.note: a prisoner of war 战俘；take sb. prisoner 俘虏某人

ex.en: There is no proof that the money was ever found.
ex.cn: 没有证据表明那笔钱曾经被找到过。
ex.note: proof of … …的证据；proof against … 反驳…的证据

ex.en: The law will punish those who steal other people's data.
ex.cn: 法律会惩罚那些窃取他人数据的人。
ex.note: punish sb. for sth. 因某事惩罚某人；punishment 惩罚

ex.en: The weather radar showed a storm moving in from the west.
ex.cn: 气象雷达显示一场风暴正从西边逼近。
ex.note: on the radar 在雷达屏幕上；under the radar 未被察觉

ex.en: By morning the team was ready to present its findings.
ex.cn: 到早上，团队已经准备好公布他们的调查结果。
ex.note: be ready for 为…做好准备；be ready to do 准备做；ready-made 现成的

ex.en: A small reduction in daily spending saved him a fortune.
ex.cn: 每天少花一点点，就替他省下了一大笔钱。
ex.note: a reduction in … …的减少；a price reduction 降价

ex.en: The police asked the company for the relevant records of that week.
ex.cn: 警方要求公司交出那一周的相关记录。
ex.note: relevant to 与…有关；the relevant records 相关记录

ex.en: The restaurant has a fine reputation for its fresh fish.
ex.cn: 这家餐厅以鲜鱼享有好名声。
ex.note: a reputation for … …的声誉；build a reputation 建立声誉

ex.en: Work on the project resumed as soon as the case was closed.
ex.cn: 案子一结，这个项目就恢复了。
ex.note: 动词读 /rɪˈzjuːm/；名词“简历”读 /ˈrezjumeɪ/。resume work 恢复工作；resume the meeting 复会

ex.en: She sent her resume to four companies last week.
ex.cn: 上周她把简历投给了四家公司。
ex.note: a resume 简历；in one's resume 在某人的简历中

ex.en: The road to the coast was closed for repairs all week.
ex.cn: 通往海岸的路整周都在维修封闭。
ex.note: on the road 在路上；a road to success 通往成功之路

ex.en: The new rule forbids the use of the old laboratory.
ex.cn: 新规定禁止使用那座旧实验室。
ex.note: the rules of … …的规则；break a rule 违反规定

ex.en: A short decision by the court ruled that the contract was valid.
ex.cn: 法院的一道简短判决裁定该合同有效。
ex.note: rule that … 裁定…；be ruled by 受…支配

ex.en: The museum is free to students on Saturday mornings.
ex.cn: 博物馆星期六上午对学生免费开放。
ex.note: on Saturday 在星期六；Saturday afternoon 星期六下午

ex.en: He got a high score on the final exam.
ex.cn: 他期末考试拿了高分。
ex.note: a score of … …的数量；on a scale of … 在…的量表上

ex.en: The team scored twice in the first half.
ex.cn: 上半场这支队进了两个球。
ex.note: score a goal 进球；score points 得分

ex.en: It was a selfish mistake, but it hurt everyone in the end.
ex.cn: 那是个自私的错误，但最后伤害了所有人。
ex.note: selfish behaviour 自私的行为；a selfish reason 自私的理由

ex.en: We sat in the shade of an old pine tree and talked.
ex.cn: 我们坐在一棵老松树的树荫下聊天。
ex.note: in the shade 在阴凉处；a shade of doubt 一点点怀疑

ex.en: The artist shaded the sky with soft blue pencil strokes.
ex.cn: 画家用柔和的蓝色笔触给天空上了阴影。
ex.note: shade sth. 遮蔽；shade into 渐变成

ex.en: Shortly afterwards, the police arrested three people.
ex.cn: 没过多久，警方就逮捕了三个人。
ex.note: shortly before/after 在…之前/之后不久

ex.en: The only real sin, in his view, was to blame the victim.
ex.cn: 在他看来，唯一真正的罪过就是责怪受害者。
ex.note: commit a sin 犯下罪过；as if it were a sin 仿佛犯了罪

ex.en: He took a large slice of bread and butter for breakfast.
ex.cn: 早餐他吃了一大片涂了黄油的面包。
ex.note: a slice of 一片；a slice of the market 市场份额的一小块

ex.en: Slice the bread thinly and put it in the toaster.
ex.cn: 把面包切成薄片，放进烤面包机。
ex.note: slice sth. up 把…切成薄片；slice through 穿过

ex.en: He fell asleep on the sofa and missed the last bus.
ex.cn: 他在沙发上睡着了，错过了末班车。
ex.note: on the sofa 在沙发上；a sofa bed 沙发床

ex.en: The milk has gone sour and smells rather strange.
ex.cn: 牛奶已经变酸了，闻起来怪怪的。
ex.note: turn sour 变酸；a sour expression 苦瓜脸

ex.en: He spilled his coffee on the report and had to print it again.
ex.cn: 他把咖啡洒在报告上，只好重新打印一份。
ex.note: spill oil 漏油；spill over 溢出到

ex.en: The university set a new standard for online security.
ex.cn: 这所大学为网络安全立下了新的标准。
ex.note: a high standard 高标准；meet standards 达标

ex.en: They use standard boxes for all the books on the shelf.
ex.cn: 书架上的书全都用统一规格的箱子装。
ex.note: standard practice 标准做法；standard size 标准尺寸

ex.en: The shop keeps a large stock of old maps and prints.
ex.cn: 这家店里存着大量旧地图和版画。
ex.note: stock exchange 证券交易所；in stock 有货；a stock of 存货

ex.en: The warehouse stocks enough paper for a whole year.
ex.cn: 仓库备的纸够用一整年。
ex.note: stock up on sth. 囤积某物；stock the shelves 补货上架

ex.en: He stripped the old paint off the wooden door.
ex.cn: 他把木门上的旧漆刮了下来。
ex.note: strip sth. off 把…剥掉；strip sb. of sth. 剥夺某人的某物

ex.en: A narrow strip of tape held the note to the door.
ex.cn: 一条窄窄的胶带把那张便条贴在门上。
ex.note: a strip of 一条；a strip of land 一条狭长的土地

ex.en: I suggest that you check the address before you pay anything.
ex.cn: 我建议你在付钱之前先核实一下地址。
ex.note: suggest doing 建议做；suggest that … 建议…；It suggests that … 这表明…

ex.en: Her mother was in surgery for three long hours.
ex.cn: 她母亲做了三个小时手术。
ex.note: have surgery 接受手术；a heart surgery 心脏手术

ex.en: Put the report on the table and we will discuss it after lunch.
ex.cn: 把报告放在桌上，午饭后我们再讨论。
ex.note: on the table 在桌上；a table of figures 一张数据表

ex.en: The teenager was the only one who had kept a copy of the message.
ex.cn: 那个少年是唯一留下消息副本的人。
ex.note: a teenager 青少年；teenagers 十几岁的孩子

ex.en: The library on the corner is the oldest building on this street.
ex.cn: 街角那座图书馆是这条街上最老的建筑。
ex.note: the + 比较级 … the more … the more …；the 用在序数词和独一无二的事物前

ex.en: The police made a thorough search of the flat and the office.
ex.cn: 警方对那套公寓和办公室做了彻底的搜查。
ex.note: a thorough investigation 彻底的调查；be thorough 做事仔细

ex.en: The timid boy hid behind his father at the party.
ex.cn: 那个胆怯的男孩在聚会上躲在父亲身后。
ex.note: timid nature 胆怯的性格；timid about 对…畏缩

ex.en: Do not touch the wet paint on the gate.
ex.cn: 别碰大门上还没干的漆。
ex.note: touch on 简要谈到；keep in touch with 与…保持联系

ex.en: He tried to keep in touch with his old classmates after graduation.
ex.cn: 毕业以后他设法和昔日的老同学保持联系。
ex.note: a touch of 一点点；get in touch with 与…取得联系

ex.en: They travelled to three other campuses to share what they had learned.
ex.cn: 他们跑了三所别的校园，分享自己的心得。
ex.note: travel around 四处旅行；travel light 轻装旅行

ex.en: There was a tube of glue on the table beside a strip of tape.
ex.cn: 桌上放着一管胶水，旁边是一条胶带。
ex.note: a tube of 一管；the tube 地铁；a test tube 试管

ex.en: They reached an understanding with the school about the fund.
ex.cn: 他们就这笔基金与学校达成了共识。
ex.note: an understanding with 与…的协议；mutual understanding 相互理解

ex.en: He urged her to check the real website before paying anything.
ex.cn: 他力劝她在付钱之前先查一查真正的网址。
ex.note: urge sb. to do 力劝某人做；urge sb. on 不断催促

ex.en: She had a strong urge to call the bank again that night.
ex.cn: 那天夜里她强烈地想再给银行打个电话。
ex.note: an urge to do 强烈想做…的冲动；resist the urge 克制冲动

ex.en: A vast collection of private data was still for sale online.
ex.cn: 大量私人数据仍在网上被人出售。
ex.note: a vast amount of 大量的；a vast region 广大的地区

ex.en: The damage was clearly visible from the other side of the road.
ex.cn: 从马路对面就能清楚看见损坏的程度。
ex.note: barely visible 几乎看不见；visible to 对…可见

ex.en: She gave him a warm smile and asked him to sit down.
ex.cn: 她朝他温暖地笑了笑，请他坐下。
ex.note: warm to 对…友善；a warm welcome 热情的欢迎

ex.en: The hot soup warmed his hands on the cold morning.
ex.cn: 冷清的早晨，那碗热汤暖了他的双手。
ex.note: warm oneself 暖身；warm to 对…渐渐产生好感

ex.en: The old man began to weep as he read the letter.
ex.cn: 老人读着那封信，泪水夺眶而出。
ex.note: weep for joy 喜极而泣；weep over 为…而哭泣

ex.en: The whole class waited for the results in silence.
ex.cn: 全班同学默默等着结果。
ex.note: the whole … 整个…；a whole day 一整天

ex.en: The whole of the money went into the fund for the victims.
ex.cn: 所有的钱都进了给受害者的那笔基金。
ex.note: as a whole 作为一个整体；the whole of 全部

ex.en: She was the only witness who could describe the caller.
ex.cn: 她是唯一能描述那个来电者的证人。
ex.note: a witness to … …的目击者；a witness for the defence 被告方证人

ex.en: Two students witnessed the accident outside the hall.
ex.cn: 两名学生目击了大厅外的这场事故。
ex.note: witness an event 目睹某事；witness sth. happening 亲眼看到某事发生

ex.en: She was a thorough writer who asked the hardest questions.
ex.cn: 她是个思路周密的作者，问出的问题最难回答。
ex.note: a writer of … …的作家；a famous writer 名作家
